original_ai_output.title_zh: 尼日利亚国家安全局就埃博拉筛查漏洞发出新警报
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 尼日利亚联邦政府就各入境口岸据报存在的埃博拉筛查协议违规情况表示关切，并下令安全机构与卫生部门加强监测。此前阿布贾确认一例输入性病例，国家安全顾问办公室对筛查协议未获遵守提出担忧。报道称，调查发现多州在公众认知、感染防控设施和应急准备方面存在缺口。

location.raw_text: entry points; imported case in Abuja

key_facts.fact: 尼日利亚联邦政府就入境口岸埃博拉筛查协议据报存在违规表示关切，并下令加强监测
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The Federal Government has raised concerns over reported breaches of Ebola screening protocols at the nation’s entry points, ordering security agencies, health institutions and other relevant authorities to tighten surveillance

key_facts.fact: 国家安全顾问办公室就筛查协议未获遵守提出担忧
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: The fresh directive followed concerns raised by the Office of the National Security Adviser over reported non-compliance with approved Ebola entry protocols

key_facts.fact: 阿布贾确认一例输入性病例
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: amid growing anxiety over the confirmation of an imported case in Abuja

key_facts.fact: 调查发现多州在公众认知、感染防控设施和应急准备方面存在缺口
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: investigations by our correspondents across several states revealed gaps in public awareness, infection prevention facilities and emergency preparedness

uncertainties: 筛查协议违规的具体情况尚未获独立确认
报道为单一来源（Punch），尚缺乏交叉验证
